decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed two storey side and single storey rear extension and roof extension, by way of their position, size, scale and appearance, respect the appearance of the area and would not harm neighbour's living conditions and therefore comply with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or western sidewalls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity areay.
description: Erection of a two storey side and single storey rear extension and a roof extension (Amended Plans).
